🫏 New post ready 📖 Story · parents · 8 slides “i pulled the yellow tape measure out of the kitchen drawer yesterday, just to see how far it would stretch.” 📝 Slides
1. i pulled the yellow tape measure out of the kitchen drawer yesterday, just to see how far it would stretch. 2. when i was small, my only job was holding the metal hook flat against the wall. 3. i thought we were building something important, because you checked the pencil mark on the wood twice. 4. but you were only putting up a crooked shelf for the shoes by the back door. 5. so when i moved into my own place, i bought the exact same heavy yellow one. 6. i hooked the end against the wall this morning to see if a desk would fit. 7. but the metal snapped back across the room, because nobody was kneeling there to hold it down. 8. thank you for pretending you needed two people to measure a piece of wood.
✍️ Caption
he let me hold the heavy end anyway, just to keep me in the room. send this to your dad if he still has a jar of mixed screws on his workbench. #dad #dadquotes #fatherdaughter #fatherson
